section_summary.extract_value: This section reports exploratory factor analysis (Varimax) of the 30-item Portuguese SATAQ-3 (KMO = .93; Bartlett's test significant), extracting four factors consistent with the original structure and reporting Cronbach's alphas for each factor. Independent-samples t-tests compared sexes (women n = 195, men n = 116; total N = 311), finding no sex differences on Information or Internalisation–Athlete but higher scores for women on Internalisation–General and Pressures.
